descriptions.w3d_d26k_team_timer_tick_8021c144: Decrements the timer at +112 by the step at +116 under the active/value/paused/flag guards; on underflow looks up services 0x8041aac8 and optionally 0x8041aae8, applies them to the team through 0x8021e930 with retain/release around each, and resets the timer to 100.
